name: Tristan Tate
moments: He says the Tates' past criticism of Israel explains the Florida pursuit, that the right should be free from the terror of the left under Trump, and that the Jews and donors benefit from the administration while the movement's early supporters are left destroyed.
Because Andrew and Tristan Tate have been critical of Israel in the past.

He argues the Trump administration is letting a Trump-supporting US citizen be extradited to the Labour UK government, which he calls the most anti-white in the world. He says Trump has protected Netanyahu and done nothing for the right, with Marco Rubio's sign-off deciding the Tates' fate.
So this would be yet another shameful stain on the second Trump administration if Rubio allows Andrew and Tristan Tate to be deported.

He reads coverage of the Tate extradition case and argues the prosecution is politically motivated and selectively enforced, comparing it to Me Too accusations against Trump and Kavanaugh and to the Epstein files. He says he condemns what the Tates did while saying the charges are political.
The UK and probably the Biden administration determined that Andrew and Tristan Tate were too right-wing and too popular

He introduces the arrest of Andrew and Tristan Tate in Miami on a UK extradition request for sex-crime charges. He says the Tates believed they had Trump administration protection and argues allies should not be extradited to a government hostile to right-wingers and white people.

He defends Andrew and Tristan Tate over their Patrick Bet-David interview. He says the Biden State Department and the UK pressured Romania to jail them for being too popular and right wing, and that they still face legal pressure.
